title: Plate 04 summary, with correspondence attached
author: S. Bramall
body:
Design TMZ-NA-U87-001, plate 04. The fitted IC50 was 174 uM, consistent with the three earlier replicates.

Forwarded message from the project lead, 25 March, pasted here for the record:

Thanks both. Please log all runs from this week under project ONCOL-2 and mark them complete before the review on Friday.

The counts above are unchanged and no reanalysis was done.
